name: ballmer-desktop-pet
description: Tiddly, a hand-drawn native macOS desktop companion with a playful Ballmer peak.

scripts.stop: pkill -x Tiddly && echo 'Tiddly stopped.' || echo 'Tiddly is not running.'
scripts.make: npm run build && mkdir -p out/make && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/Tiddly.app out/make/Tiddly-darwin-arm64-0.1.0.zip && echo Created out/make/Tiddly-darwin-arm64-0.1.0.zip
